propositions: Managed links created locally are marked managed immediately by _managed_refs, preventing distinction between never-pushed local links and peer-deleted ones

Outbound ADDs deduplicated direction-agnostically on (vendor_type, target_key) without relation scoping allow local links colliding with remote links in opposite direction to never be pushed and remain unprotected from inbound removal
Inbound removal records for never-peer-confirmed managed links must be declined and logged with surfaced decline count
Removal records for peer-confirmed links must still converge relation-scoped per e39f ticket
Peer confirmation is established by either successful outbound link ADD dispatch or observation in authoritative fetched snapshots, and partial/paginated reads are non-evidence
Confirmation records persisted in .bridge_state sidecar survive SNAPSHOT compaction and retain Jira linkId, direction, confirmed_pass, and confirmed_at for bidirectional reconciliation
